correctness.rationale: The entire face sets on 5 and 6 polygon vertices are reconstructed by testing every directed-arc subset. All 190 and 576 Hasse incidences are explicitly visited and the reversed matching digraphs topologically sorted without cycles. The critical CW models have cells 0,2,3,3 and 0,2,4,4 respectively. For the first complex, exact rational boundary ranks 21,8 force both three-cell degrees to be zero; the integer Morse differential is then zero. For the second, a signed primitive integral 2-cocycle supported on eight triangles is a genuine cocycle, evaluates 1 on an explicit octahedral integral 2-cycle, and has zero Alexander–Whitney cochain square on all 12 four-faces, so both Hopf attachments vanish by the classical 4-cell cup-square lemma. No infinite-parameter inference is made. A standalone verifier with no external dependencies replays every finite certificate.

value.rationale: These are the first two simply connected finite test cases of a named open wedge-of-spheres question. The five-vertex result strengthens the known connectivity lower bound from path-connectedness to simple connectivity at the first n divisible by four in the source indexing. The six-vertex calculation resolves nontrivial four-dimensional Hopf attaching maps rather than simply computing or restating known free homology; CP^2-style attachments are a genuine possible obstruction. The two concise complete integral homotopy classifications motivate subsequent family-wide study.
